## GHL 1. AI Text Booking Assistant

**In simple words:** a client texts the salon's GoHighLevel number. GoHighLevel passes the text here. The AI checks Square for real open times, books in Square, and answers **through GoHighLevel**, so the whole chat shows in your GoHighLevel inbox.

It adds the tag **needs-card** when it sends the card link, and **needs-human** when a person should step in.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ limit: 1, query: { filter: { phone_number: { exact: $json.phone } } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ idempotency_key: 'ghl-' + $('Config').first().json.contactId, phone_number: $('Config').first().json.phone, given_name: $('Config').first().json.firstName || undefined, family_name: $('Config').first().json.lastName || undefined, reference_id: $('Config').first().json.contactId, note: 'Created by the text booking assistant' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ customFields: [ { key: 'card_link', field_value: $json.cardLink }, { key: 'square_customer_id', field_value: $json.customerId } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: { filter: { location_id: $('Config').first().json.locationId, start_at_range: { start_at: $fromAI('range_start', 'Start of the search window, ISO 8601 with offset', 'string'), end_at: $fromAI('range_end', 'End of the search window, ISO 8601 with offset. Must be at least 24 hours after range_start', 'string') }, segment_filters: [{ service_variation_id: $fromAI('service_variation_id', 'service_variation_id for the chosen stylist and service', 'string'), team_member_id_filter: { any: [ $fromAI('team_member_id', 'team_member_id of the stylist', 'string') ] } }] } } }) }}
parameters.toolDescription: Find open appointment times in Square for ONE stylist and ONE service. Returns availabilities with start_at, team_member_id, service_variation_id and service_variation_version.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ idempotency_key: $('Prepare for AI').first().json.customerId + '-' + $fromAI('booking_key', 'Copy the exact start_at value here again. Used to stop double bookings.', 'string'), booking: { location_id: $('Config').first().json.locationId, customer_id: $('Prepare for AI').first().json.customerId, start_at: $fromAI('start_at', 'Exact start_at from check_availability', 'string'), customer_note: 'Booked by the text assistant', appointment_segments: [{ team_member_id: $fromAI('team_member_id', 'team_member_id from check_availability', 'string'), service_variation_id: $fromAI('service_variation_id', 'service_variation_id from check_availability', 'string'), service_variation_version: $fromAI('service_variation_version', 'service_variation_version number from check_availability', 'number') }] } }) }}
parameters.toolDescription: Create the booking in Square. Only call after the customer clearly said YES. Only works when the customer has a card on file.
List this customer's upcoming bookings (id, version, start_at, status, stylist).

parameters.url: ={{ $('Config').first().json.squareBaseUrl + '/v2/bookings/' + $fromAI('booking_id', 'id of the booking to cancel, from list_my_bookings', 'string') + '/cancel' }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ booking_version: $fromAI('booking_version', 'version number of the booking, from list_my_bookings', 'number') }) }}
parameters.toolDescription: Cancel one of this customer's bookings. Only call after they confirmed which one.
